inputs.counts_difference: 40 raw IR records; 39 have review_ready encoding admission; 1 raw IR is encoding_not_admitted; 2 admitted records sit in development-probe families and are excluded from any split
inputs.provenance_note: The read-only audit path is this round evidence source only; later stages must restore admission from the frozen IDs and digests inside this plan, not from that private path.

rules.request_text_source: IR.state.request.text, non-empty string, verified equal to the prompt source selected by qwen.prompt request_source_id
rules.closure: union-find over all 40 raw IRs; any equal key value merges groups; transitive closure
rules.probe_rule: any connected family containing a probe case is excluded from train/development/calibration/test; other admitted records of the same family are excluded too
rules.admission_meaning: encoding_admitted reflects review_ready encoding admission only; it is not label review and not a training authorization
rules.no_label_use: no label, target, Case outcome or question label value was read or used; question digest was rebuilt only as {name: IR.question} without labels
rules.source_vs_management_actor: management_actor is the assistant session that generated this plan; source_actor_session_id per record is the origin trace session, not a reviewer

method.eligible_definition: single collection: Object.entries(records) sorted by sample_id, filtered by record.encoding_admitted === true && record.excluded_reasons.length === 0
method.exact_difference_assertion: asserted equal to review_ready admitted ids minus all development-probe family members minus other excluded admitted records
method.no_sample_id_from_dict_value: eligibility iterates Object.entries(records); no record value is queried for a sample_id field
method.reference_comparison: records mapping, family identity and mapping_sha256 were compared with the preserved previous corrected plan; equality recorded instead of inventing a new identity

partition_feasibility.reason: four non-empty partitions (train/development/calibration/test) plus calibration_folds=2 need at least 5 independent families
partition_feasibility.note: count-only feasibility; no partition assignment, no seed selection or scan, no label or Case-result use; final qualified labels and the real split must still verify calibration>=2

scope_notes: All 40 raw IRs are retained in the source corpus; exclusions are plan-level only and delete no data.
The 1 non-admitted raw IR remains encoding_not_admitted and must not be counted as reviewed or trainable.
Probe families are excluded entirely even where other members are encoding-admitted; a probe case absent from the batch is recorded as absent rather than fabricated.
Downstream compile input should consume eligible_sample_ids and family_id while preserving each original source_group_id and this mapping_sha256.
